prompt_text: I need a personal injury attorney in Chicago after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
Below are several reputable Chicago personal-injury law firms that commonly handle car-accident cases, with brief reasons why you might call each. Call several and compare — most handle cases on contingency (no fee unless they recover money) and offer free consultations.

Top firms to consider

- Clifford Law Offices
  - Why: Long-established Chicago firm with extensive experience in serious auto collisions and catastrophic injury litigation and strong trial experience. Good if your case involves major injury or complex liability issues.

- Corboy & Demetrio
  - Why: High-profile plaintiff’s firm known for significant verdicts and settlements in auto-accident and catastrophic-injury cases. Strong courtroom presence if the case may need to go to trial.

- Levin & Perconti
  - Why: Focus on catastrophic injuries and wrongful death from vehicle collisions; experienced with high-value claims and dealing with medical/loss-of-earnings issues.

- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.
  - Why: Regional trial firm with a long history handling motor vehicle crashes, including serious injury claims. Often helpful for complex medical-liability elements after a crash.

- Sulaiman Law Group (Chicago office)
  - Why: Frequently advertises car-accident representation, handles many vehicle-collision cases, and often works on contingency with quick intake and active client communication.

- Power Rogers & Smith, LLP
  - Why: Known for personal-injury practice in Illinois, handling auto accidents and wrongful-death cases; offers experience in both negotiation and trial.

- Schiller DuCanto & Fleck LLP
  - Why: Strong trial record in serious injury and wrongful-death matters; good for complex or catastrophic cases requiring substantial litigation resources.

- Goldberg Weisman Cairo
  - Why: Longtime Chicago personal-injury firm experienced with car collisions and insurance claims, with a history of successful settlements and trials.

How to choose which to call
- Call 3–5 firms and compare:
  - Ask whether they have recent experience with cases like yours (similar injuries/accident types).
  - Ask about trial experience and whether they’ll trial the case if needed.
  - Confirm contingency-fee terms, costs you might be expected to pay, and whether they front expenses.
  - Ask who will handle the case day-to-day (partner vs. associate).
  - Ask for a case timeline and estimated value range (understanding they’ll need details to give a real estimate).
  - Request references or recent case results in similar matters.

Practical next steps
- Seek medical attention immediately if you haven’t already. Document injuries, treatment, and expenses.
- Preserve evidence (photos, police report number, witness names/contacts).
- If you’d like, tell me a bit about the accident (where in Chicago, injuries, police report, insurance details), and I’ll help you narrow this list to the best fits for your situation or draft a short phone script/questions to use when you call.

I’m not your lawyer; this is general guidance. For case-specific legal advice, schedule consultations with one or more of the firms above.
